decisive_items: a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern isodense to gray matter without calcifications
a 3.4×3.3×3.3 cm, well-circumscribed mass in the left cerebellomedullary and premedullary cisterns that was hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
response.rationale: R1 is favored because the well-circumscribed posterior fossa mass with T1/T2 hyperintensity to CSF and no listed contradictions fits hemangioblastoma better. R2 is contradicted by the explicit lack of enhancement, which is atypical for meningioma.

rejected.why: No enhancement contradicts typical meningioma; vessel displacement without encasement is non-specific.
